_comment: FICTIONAL golden expectations for the forecast-from-assumptions engine, derived BY HAND from tests/fixtures/fees/RULES.md (sections A-D), schedules.json -> standard, the pricing fixtures (rate card, service terms, rules, pricing/expected.json totals) and m4-design-v2.md section 7, independent of src/engine/forecast. Every _working string shows the arithmetic. Money 'E4' = integer ten-thousandths of a dollar; cents/'monthly'/'perOrder' strings are HALF_UP 2 dp rounded once from the exact E4 figure. Weights are exact decimals (compare numerically; canonical form has no trailing zeros). Cell key = parcel<i>|zone<j>|service|res0|pkg1 with i, j the 0-based indexes into assumptions.parcels / assumptions.zones; 'service' is literal (one service); res0 = residentialPct 0; pkg1 = one package per order.
_ambiguities: A1/A7 inserts in a forecast: A7 defines q PER ORDER (countPerOrder = 4 when the order qualifies, 0 otherwise) and A1 applies the free allowance to that order's q, so a qualifying order is charged max(0, 4 - 1) x 0.25 = $0.75 (7500 E4) and a non-qualifying order nothing (A5). The expected value over a mix in which 40.00% of orders qualify is 0.40 x 7500 = 3000 E4 = $0.30 per order, expected chargeable quantity 0.40 x 3 = 1.2; at 1000 orders this is the $300.00 a file run of 1000 such orders is charged under the same rule (400 qualifying orders x $0.75). The first draft of this fixture applied the allowance to the expected quantity 0.4 x 4 = 1.6 -> max(0, 1.6 - 1) = 0.6 x 0.25 = $0.15 (1500 E4); that quantity exists on no order under A7 and understates the charge (E[max(0, n - 1)] >= max(0, E[n] - 1)), so it was corrected when the golden test was written; the two readings coincide only at sharePct = 100.

Forecast reclass: A8 alone would class pick_order and the packaging lines definite (no assumed quantity read); design section 7 [M5] re-classes every counted line of a forecast estimated, so shipping and processing definite = 0 and every order line below is 'estimated'. The month-basis admin line stays definite (design section 10 carve-out, RULES.md B1).

Handling warning: every cell's shipping carries the conditional address-correction exposure (21.00) and undecided DAS lines, so OrderShippingInput.hasExposure = true and each order-fee result carries warning fee_base_excludes_exposure (A6). Tests may choose not to assert warnings.

'replaced' entries (pack_other) are listed in OrderFeeResult.unresolved with reason replaced but do not make status partial (A10) and do not enter the minimum bucket's unresolvedRuleKeys, so the minimum stays 'exact'.
Cell weights are exact integers here (420/180/280/120); canonical string form is Decimal.toString() with no trailing zeros.

shipping._working: 1 lb 6x4x2 (cubic 48; DIM 48/139 = 0.3453 < 1 lb actual) -> billable 1 lb (actual). Zone 2 bracket 0-1 lb = 7.90; service minimum 8.50 > 7.90 -> minimum-charge adjustment 0.60 (base freight 7.90 + 0.60 = 8.50). DAS (4.00) and extended DAS (6.00) cannot be decided without a ZIP -> estimated, uncounted. Address correction 21.00 conditional, uncounted. Fuel v2 (asOf 2026-10-15 >= 2026-10-01) 15.50% x 8.50 = 1.3175 -> 1.32. Counted total 7.90 + 0.60 + 1.32 = 9.82 = 98,200 E4 (pricing scenario ground_minimum_charge: 9.82).

minimum._working: C over ONE average month: bucket {month 'average', fraction 1, modeledOrders 1000, shippedOrders 1000 (no coverage scaling), shippingExpectedE4 128,950,000 (not counted: includesShipping false), unresolvedRuleKeys []}. counted = sum over resolvedRuleKeys of each rule's month total rounded to cents: order-scope pick_order 25,000,000 E4 = 2500.00; pick_additional 4,000,000 = 400.00; pack_mailer 1,800,000 = 180.00; pack_box 3,400,000 = 340.00; pack_other 0 = 0.00; monthly-scope x fraction 1: storage_pallet 120.00; storage_long_term 44.00; receiving_pallet 48.00; receiving_case 70.00; counted = 2500 + 400 + 180 + 340 + 120 + 44 + 48 + 70 = 3702.00 = 37,020,000 E4. minimum = 500 x 1 = 500.00; topUp = max(0, 500.00 - 3702.00) = 0. Status exact (nothing not modeled, no bucket-unresolved keys, modeled = shipped). The minimum does not bind at 1000 orders, so topUp is a legitimate zero here. Excluded from R (not counted): inserts and handling_pct (category other), returns (category returns), admin (category account).
